description: Turns a view-only DocumentCompareResult into a tracked-changes 'redline' document: word-level diff segments become insertion/deletion revision runs, added/removed blocks become whole-block insertions/deletions (removed blocks are woven back at their base position), and formatting-only changes are recorded as formatting revisions. Output is an ordinary document, so the DOCX exporter (w:ins/w:del), the canvas track-changes UI and the PDF pipeline consume it without new model concepts. Deterministic for identical inputs when a fixed DocumentRedlineOptions.Timestamp is supplied.
